limitations: Includes inherited, generated, trace and authored Static corrections; excludes character-specific Dynamic corrections, derived passes and localization.

Missing flags do not imply pooled or independent loot; current Forever behavior is not observed by this import.

objectiveText: Go to Sven's Farm and find what was buried behind the old stump.
Bring the Book from Sven's Farm to Sven.
Take the book you found at Sven's farm and show it to townsfolk in Darkshire.
See if other townsfolk have clues about the shadowy figure.
Search the inn for clues about the shadowy figure.
Find the Shadowy Figure. Your clues:
He is not native to Darkshire.
He is a nervous, jittery person.
He left Darkshire and headed west.
Return to Sven with Jitters' completed journal.
Kill 15 Skeletal Raiders, 3 Skeletal Healers and 3 Skeletal Warders, and then return to Sven.

dungeonKillXpReference.source: Owner-supplied planning range: a level-20 dungeon elite killed by five level-20 players gives 24–30 XP per player. Build and sample context are unverified; other levels use a solo-base and level-weighted-share extrapolation. No further division by five, party bonus or patch bonus.

directives.text: If you can't pick up this quest you need to abandon Sven's Revenge from your quest log
Click the Mound of loose dirt on the ground
Talk to Clerk Daltry in the town hall building
Turn in The Shadowy Search Continues
Talk to Tavernkeep Smitts inside the inn
Turn in Inquire at the Inn
Turn in Finding the Shadowy Figure
Kill Skeletal Raiders, Skeletal Healers and Skeletal Warders
Enter the Dawning Wood Catacombs for the Skeletal Warders
Mor'Ladim a level 35 Elite patrols around the cemetery. Be cautious of him
